mirrorHoles.Name: Mirror holes into the level below
mirrorHoles.Hint: When a hole or stair is cut into a floor, cut the same opening into the ceiling of the level below.

autoTag.Name: Auto-tag new placeables to the active level
autoTag.Hint: Walls, tiles, sounds and notes placed while Floorer is open are tagged to the active level. Lights get elevation only and stay untagged so light spills through openings.

sealBasements.Name: Seal basements by default
sealBasements.Hint: Generated basement levels see only themselves.

Armed.footprint: Draw the floor footprint for {level}. Esc to cancel.
Armed.hole: Draw a hole in the floor of {level}. Esc to cancel.
Armed.stair: Draw the stair area on {level}. Esc to cancel.

Intent.TargetMissing: The stair target level no longer exists.
Intent.SurfaceMissing: Draw the floor footprint first, then cut holes.
Intent.WriteFailed: Floorer could not update the surface regions.

Setup.Title: Set up levels
Setup.ImagesHint: Optional background image per level. Leave a row blank to keep the scene background.
Setup.NoLevels: Add at least one floor, basement or roof.
Setup.Conflict: These Floorer-managed levels do not match the new bands: {names}. Keep them and add only the new levels, or replace them?
Setup.AdoptDefault: Use the existing default level as the ground floor
Setup.TooManyImages: More images than levels were given; extra images were ignored.

Tip.FloorsAbove: Number of above-ground floors. Each becomes a level one floor height tall, starting at the ground elevation.
Tip.Basements: Number of underground floors below the ground elevation. Basements are sealed by default: they see only themselves.
Tip.Roof: Adds an open-topped level above the last floor for rooftops and flying tokens.
Tip.FloorHeight: Vertical size of each level in scene units. Level bands are stacked using this height.
Tip.GroundBottom: Elevation where the ground floor starts. Floors stack upward from here, basements downward.
Tip.AdoptDefault: Reuse the scene's existing default level as the ground floor instead of creating a new one, so nothing overlaps.
Tip.Images: Optional background image per level, shown when that level is viewed. Leave blank to keep the scene background.

Panel.BandInvalid: Enter numbers (or leave blank for open ends) with bottom not above top.
Panel.ConfirmDeleteStair: Delete this stair and the openings it cut into the floors?
Panel.ConfirmDeleteHole: Delete this hole and its mirrored opening below?

Tip.Footprint: The floor of this level. Draw its outline; Floorer creates a Define Surface region that blocks sight, light and movement between floors, tagged to every level that can see it.
Tip.FootprintPolygon: Draw the floor outline as a polygon
Tip.FootprintRect: Draw the floor outline as a rectangle
Tip.FootprintWhole: Use the whole map as the floor
Tip.Hole: An opening in this floor (balcony, mezzanine, shaft). Draw the shape; the same opening is cut into the ceiling of the level below so tokens can see through it.
Tip.HoleDraw: Draw a hole in this floor
Tip.Stair: A connector between this level and the target. Tokens walking into it are prompted to change level. Floorer places the region in the lower level's band, tags both levels and cuts matching openings.
Tip.StairDraw: Draw the stair area on this level

Panel.SealTooltip: Sealed: this level sees only itself. Click to unseal.
Panel.UnsealTooltip: Click to seal: only this level will see itself.
Panel.RevertConfirm: Undo all {count} Floorer changes made since this scene was opened?
Panel.NoTarget: Pick a target level for the stair first.
Panel.NoScene: Open a scene before using Floorer.
